{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace D04

structure Comparator where
  op : String
  version : String
  deriving Inhabited

def Clause := List Comparator

structure Input where
  versions : List String
  clauses : List Clause
  deriving Inhabited

structure Output where
  accepted : List String
  invalid : List Nat
  deriving Inhabited

opaque solve : Input → Output
opaque validSemVer : String → Prop
opaque comparatorValid : Comparator → Prop
opaque strictParsing : Input → Output → Prop
opaque semVerPrecedence : Input → Output → Prop
opaque clauseMatching : Input → Output → Prop
opaque outputOrderingAndIndices : Input → Output → Prop
opaque publicExamples : Prop
opaque pureStandardLibrary : Input → Output → Prop
opaque boundedNumericSupport : Input → Output → Prop

theorem O1 : ∀ i : Input, strictParsing i (solve i) := by sorry

theorem O2 : ∀ i : Input, semVerPrecedence i (solve i) := by sorry

theorem O3 : ∀ i : Input, clauseMatching i (solve i) := by sorry
theorem O4 : ∀ i : Input, outputOrderingAndIndices i (solve i) := by sorry
theorem O5 : publicExamples := by sorry
theorem I1 : ∀ i : Input, pureStandardLibrary i (solve i) := by sorry
theorem R1 : ∀ i : Input, boundedNumericSupport i (solve i) := by sorry
